message.content: In order that the vapour which exhales from the distilling vessels may not prove inconvenient, it is necessary to pour in a small quantity of alkaline lixivium in the first place, which instantly destroys the smell. This may be done immediately after the end of the distillation, and the weak alkaline solution may supply the place of the water used for diluting the residues. At the instant of pouring this lixivial water, a strong effervescence takes place; for which reason it is proper to pour it in by several successive portions, waiting a little between each time.
